title: MINUTE ChIP
author: Banushree Kumar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8nkhvcw
materials: Elution from protein G beads and protein digestion
Then add : Incubate in a thermocycler with following program :

steps.title: Cell Harvesting and Lysis
steps.instruction: Harvest 10^6 cells, spin, and flash freeze the pellet, ensuring minimal excess liquid.

steps.title: MNase Digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the frozen cell pellet in 50 µL of ice-cold PBS and digest with MNase.

substeps.instruction: Prepare MNase mix: Add 20 μl protease inhibitor to 1 ml 2x lysis buffer (2xLyB), then stepwise dilute MNase (M0247S NEB 2000 U/ul) to 20U/μl and then 2U/μl in 2x LyB (Final working conc. = 2U/μl in 2xLyB).
Add 50 µL of MNase mix (final 2U/ul in 2xLyB for mouse embryonic stem cells) to the cells.
Lyse cells on ice for 20 minutes.
Digest at 37 °C for 10 minutes with agitation at 800 rpm.
Transfer tubes on ice.

steps.title: T7 Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate T7 adapters to the digested cells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare enzyme mix.
Quickly add 36.6 µL enzyme mix to 40 µL of digested cells, then add 4 µL of unique T7 adapter (Total volume ~80 μl).
Mix and incubate with agitation at 800 rpm at Room temperature for 2 hours (optional: incubate at 16 °C overnight).
On the next day, add 1x protease inhibitor (100x) to Lysis dilution buffer and add 80 µL of this to each sample to end the reaction (Total volume: 160 µL).

steps.title: Antibody-Bead Coupling
steps.instruction: Prepare the magnetic beads by coupling them with the appropriate antibody.

substeps.instruction: Wash 50 µL Protein G/A beads with 2x 1000 µL PBS-T(0.1%).
Resuspend beads in 200 µL PBS-T(0.1%) and incubate with the appropriate amount of antibodies for 1 hour at Room temperature.
Wash coupled beads quickly with 200 µL RIPA and resuspend in 50 µL Lysis dilution buffer.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Perform the immunoprecipitation of the pooled lysate.

substeps.instruction: Top up beads with 200 - 400 μl of pooled lysate for each IP and rotate for 4 hours at 4 °C.
Wash the samples.
Magnetize samples and save the supernatant at -20 ºC for efficiency checks.

Perform the following wash sequence (resuspend, rotate 5 mins, magnetize, and aspirate): 2x with 500 μl ice cold RIPA buffer, 1x with 500 μl ice cold RIPA/high salt buffer, 2x with 500 μl ice cold LiCl wash buffer, and 1x with 200 μl ice cold TE (quick wash and change to new tube).

steps.title: Chromatin Elution and Recovery
steps.instruction: Elute the chromatin and recover the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend chromatin/antibody/beads in 97.5 µL of ChIP elution buffer and 2.5 µL of Proteinase K (process the INPUT sample similarly).
Digest at 63 °C for 1 hour (native chromatin) or overnight (fixed chromatin).

Perform SPRI bead cleanup: Transfer 100 µL eluate to new wells, add 100 µL SPRI beads (1x), mix by pipetting, wait 10 minutes, magnetize for 5 minutes, remove supernatant, wash 2x with 200 µL 70% ethanol (magnetize 1 minute), air-dry at RT for >= 5 minutes, and elute DNA in 12 µL EB.
Measure 1 µL with Qubit.

steps.title: Pooling and Input Saving
steps.instruction: Combine samples and set aside the input control.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to a fresh tube, saving 5-10% of the volume as input.
Combine all samples into a single tube and spin down at 24000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Library Preparation and IVT
steps.instruction: Prepare the library via In Vitro Transcription (IVT) and reverse transcription.

substeps.instruction: Prepare IVT mix in PCR tubes using as much ChIP DNA as possible.
Set up the ligation reaction per sample and incubate at 25 °C for 2 hours.
Move tube to ice and add reverse transcription reaction components; heat to 65 °C for 5 minutes and place on ice for 1 minute.
Add 1 µL Rnase H (DNase free) and incubate for 15 minutes at 37 °C.
Perform PCR using specified cycling conditions.
Incubate samples at 37 °C overnight (roughly 16 hours).

steps.title: RNA Isolation (Silane Bead Cleanup)
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA using Silane beads at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Magnetize 15 µL Silane beads per sample, wash with 60 µL buffer RLT, magnetize, aspirate, and resuspend in 60 µL buffer RLT.
Add 60 µL washed beads to 20 µL sample, wait 1 minute.
Add 48 µL 100% EtOH (final 0.6x), mix well, wait 5 minutes (pipette at 2.5 min).
Magnetize, wash 2x with 200 µL 70% EtOH, air-dry at RT for at least 5 minutes.
Elute RNA in 10 µL EB and measure 1 µL on Qubit.

steps.title: cDNA Purification and Final Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform final SPRI bead cleanups to isolate DNA.

substeps.instruction: First SPRI cleanup: Add 50 µL nuclease free water to PCR mixture (final 100 µL), add 100 µL SPRI beads (1x), mix, wait 10 minutes, magnetize 5 minutes, remove supernatant, wash 2x with 200 µL 70% ethanol, air-dry >= 5 minutes, and elute in 20 µL elution buffer. Measure 1 µL on Qubit.
Adjust cDNA concentration to 150 ng (min 100 ng) in 22.5 µL total volume with nuclease free water and set up PCR reaction mix.

Second SPRI cleanup: Add 59 µL nuclease free water to cDNA mixture (final 100 µL), add 100 µL SPRI beads (1x), mix, wait 10 minutes, magnetize 5 minutes, remove supernatant, wash 2x with 200 µL 70% ethanol, air-dry >= 5 minutes, and elute in 24 µL TE. Measure concentration on Nanodrop.
